name: Face mist
definition: water-based spray misted onto the face to hydrate or refresh skin, over or under make-up.
notes: Tower 28 sells SOS Daily Rescue Facial Spray as a facial spray, usable over makeup.

name: Acne spot treatment
definition: paste, gel or cream dabbed on a single blemish to dry or calm it.
notes: Retailer category Acne Spot Treatments lists spot gels, dabbers and patches.

name: Pimple patch
definition: small hydrocolloid sticker worn over a blemish, plain or with an active ingredient.
notes: Shop collection Pimple Patches (21 products); Hero Mighty Patch, COSRX Master Patch listed.

name: Facial skin-care device
definition: hand-held powered device for facial skin (microcurrent toning, LED, cooling or depuffing wand); a plain massager is H1.9.02.
notes: NuFACE Trinity+ microcurrent device sold under Skincare Tools for toning and lifting the face.

name: Facial razor (dermaplaning razor)
definition: small single-blade razor for brows, peach fuzz and dermaplaning the face.
notes: Tweezerman Facial Razor: stainless blade, three spare blades, removes peach fuzz.

name: Highlighter
definition: shimmering powder, cream or liquid placed on the high points of the face to catch light.
notes: Smashbox Becca pressed facial highlighter swept on cheek high points.

name: Contour
definition: cool-toned stick, cream, liquid or powder used to shade and sculpt the face; a warm bronzer is H1.2.1.06.
notes: Ulta Contouring category, 69 products: sticks, creams, liquids, powders.

name: Makeup sponge
definition: sponge or blender used damp or dry to apply and blend foundation, concealer and cream products.
notes: Makeup Sponges collection: Beautyblender, Real Techniques, e.l.f. blenders.

name: Leave-in conditioner
definition: conditioner in cream, milk, foam or spray form left in the hair after washing.

name: Detangling spray
definition: spray or lotion that loosens knots so wet or dry hair can be combed.
notes: Detanglers collection lists detangling sprays and mists.

name: Scalp scrub
definition: exfoliating scrub with salt, sugar or grains massaged into the scalp before shampoo.
notes: Scalp Exfoliating Scrubs category with salt, sugar and acid scrubs.

name: Scalp treatment
definition: serum, tonic or acid treatment applied to the scalp (detox, soothing, oil control); a minoxidil medicine is not this kind.
notes: Scalp Treatments category, 144 products: serums, pre-wash oils, scrubs.

name: Dry shampoo
definition: powder or aerosol that absorbs oil at the roots without water.
notes: Dry Shampoo category: powders that absorb oil and add volume.

name: Hair mousse
definition: foam styling product for volume, curl definition or light hold.
notes: Styling foam category; styling mousse and foam are the same product.

name: Hair gel
definition: gel styling product that sets hair or curls with firm hold.
notes: Hair Styling Gels category, 67 products, curl gels and strong-hold gels.

name: Texturizing or sea-salt spray
definition: spray giving grit, texture or beachy waves, with salt or polymers.
notes: Sea Salt Spray category for beachy texture on damp or dry hair.

name: Volumizing spray
definition: spray applied at the roots of damp hair to lift and thicken before drying.
notes: Root Lifter collection of volumising root lifting sprays, 14 products.

name: Hair towel
definition: towel or wrap shaped or sized for drying hair, often microfibre or turban-shaped.
notes: Turban Towels collection: microfibre hair towels and towel turbans.
